title: parallax evidence bundle envelope (bundle-v2)
description: Approved Option C contract (docs/research/decisions/evidence-bundle-contract.md, 2026-07-17): a CloudEvents-profile envelope around the immutable bundle-v1 dossier carried verbatim as `data`. This schema governs the envelope; `data` is additionally validated against evidence-bundle.v1.schema.json with its schema_version pinned by this file. Self-contained — no remote $refs.

bundle_id.description: Caller-assigned stable identity for this bundle document.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 (RFC 3339) UTC. Envelope times are ISO-8601 by decision; the dossier payload keeps nanosecond strings.

generator.description: Build identity. Excluded from canonical_hash, mirroring bundle-v1.

project.description: Project identity. Conversion from v1 fails closed when absent — never fabricated.

policy.description: The only access-policy label shipped until plan 109 opens remote scope.

data.description: The immutable bundle-v1 dossier, verbatim. Deep shape is governed by evidence-bundle.v1.schema.json; conformance tests validate `data` against it separately so this file stays self-contained.

canonical_hash.description: Version-scoped RFC 8785 (JCS) SHA-256; never interchangeable with the v1 sorted-key sha256: hash. Excludes itself, generator, and the payload's generator/canonical_hash/bounded.
